title: iPad layout QA
description: Build and run the app on an iPad simulator. Execute the full QA pass: (1) rotate between portrait and landscape and confirm columnVisibility transitions correctly; (2) fire aggregator://thread/{id} and aggregator://article/{id} deep links and confirm the correct section and item open on iPad; (3) exercise all 6 sidebar sections in both orientations; (4) confirm all existing iPhone XCTest tests pass without modification; (5) verify iPhone layout is unchanged by comparing screen output.
acceptance_criteria: App installs and launches on iPad simulator without crashing
Landscape shows all 3 columns; portrait shows 2 columns
Rotating between orientations live-transitions columnVisibility correctly
All 6 sections reachable and functional via sidebar
Content column selection opens correct detail in detail column (landscape)
Content column tap pushes correct detail (portrait)
aggregator://thread/{id} deep link navigates correctly on iPad
aggregator://article/{id} deep link navigates correctly on iPad
All existing iPhone XCTest tests pass unmodified
